title: MZ Looking for a theater (like plays not movies) battleback, matching tileset would be a bonus

posts.author: james5272
posts.body:
Basically want to have a monster arena in my game that takes place with fighting monsters on the stage of a theater. There is a tileset on Steam that is a theater, KR Art Deco Theater Tileset, but I am not sure if it has a matching battleback. If anyone knows that it does, that would solve this problem right away. Otherwise, it would be ideal to have a theater stage battleback that matches a theater tileset. And, if that fails, I might look into paying someone to do a theater battleback that matches the theater tileset I found on Steam.
Or, alternatively, if I don't specify a battleback for a tileset, does it just take place on the map, so it would have the theater tileset in the background for the battle? That would save me money, if it ends up being the only option for a proper battleback is paying for it. I try to keep the budget on my games low since I'm not really expecting to get my money back.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
james5272 said:
KR Art Deco Theater Tileset, but I am not sure if it has a matching battleback. If anyone knows that it does
Click to expand...
KR does not make battle backs for their tile sets.
james5272 said:
if I don't specify a battleback for a tileset, does it just take place on the map
Click to expand...
You can just try for yourself
But to answer your question: yes and no.
Technically what happens is the game takes a screenshot of your tiles, then use that screen shot as the battle back, so it is not literally taking place on the map. In addition to this, it applies a blur filter to the screen shot, so it also doesn't look your on the map, but... Kind of hovering above it. Not sure why the devs decided to go with that, but that's how it is.
You can find plugins that change this behavior though. I don't know any off the top of my head, but I'm sure googling something like "RPG maker mz map battle plugin" or "battle on map plugin" or "remove battle back blur" would turn up some results.
That said, maybe someone knows of a battle back that can accommodate you.

posts.author: james5272
posts.body:
Thanks! I have it functioning in game. I have VisuStella Battlecore set to have battlebacks scale to fit. For some reason this was working fine to have other battlebacks fit the screen, but the battleback you provided, despite being the same dimensions, was being zoomed in (so ie. the front of the stage was missing). I tried all the different Battlecore battleback settings and couldn't get it to work. My project is 1920x1080, so I used Paint to stretch your battleback to 1920x1080, then used that in game, and it's working fine now. Not sure why this was needed. Will this create issue if someone plays at a different resolution than the project is in? Or am I correct in thinking project resolution is how it decides to display things, regardless of display resolution?
EDIT: So, it could be, I'm using the CGMZ Colosseum plugin for the theatre battles. Maybe it's doing something with the battleback scaling. Not sure. I am just curious if my fix (making the battleback the project resolution) is OK or if it might cause me a headache down the line.
